status: development-only all-frame reconstruction control on an already-open case

supersedes_before_execution.reason: Source-independent audits found that the original runner did not install the part-aware decoder, the staged byte-bound proxy used the registered compact edge-semantics contract, and upstream's provisional 8:2 loader split is empty for one case before its case-specific branch replaces both loaders. Version 1.2 binds the narrow single-case provisional-split compatibility used by the smoke. No 200-epoch training or outcome was produced under the superseded protocols.

claim_boundary: This control deliberately fits future RGB, geometry, and track observations from the same case. It tests a new Bayesian-PhysTwin part-aware MatPhys variant, not the published MatPhys method, and cannot support a causal forecast, transfer result, calibration result, or state-of-the-art claim.
question: Can a MatPhys decoder with an explicitly wired DINO graph-part adapter fit an already-open PhysTwin case well enough to justify a later source-only causal transfer design?

case.selection: canonical previously opened development case used throughout the MatPhys causal audits

implementation.architecture: released SimpleVideoMaterialPhysicsModel plus Bayesian-PhysTwin DINO part-conditioning adapter
implementation.video_frame_order: numeric filename stems, 16 uniformly sampled over all 85 frames
implementation.compact_proxy_boundary: The compact proxy preserves the full proxy's train_ready.pt, 1024-dimensional part descriptors, part assignments, material distributions, and graph provenance byte-for-byte. It replaces only node/edge semantic tensors that the simple part-aware decoder does not consume.
implementation.proxy_boundary: MatPhys does not release its final per-case train_ready.pt bundle. The deterministic Bayesian-PhysTwin DINO graph-part proxy and adapter are new components, not official MatPhys artifacts.

controls.released_phystwin: the released inference.pkl on the same case
controls.published_matphys_public_artifact_contro: 12.212 mm case-balanced CD and 26.881 mm track on 22 cases, explicitly noncausal
controls.official_metric_contract: released PhysTwin CD and frame-zero manual-identity track metrics

decision_rule.capacity_pass: terminal trajectory improves both released-test CD and released-test track error versus released PhysTwin and has finite learned parameters
decision_rule.backend_export_pass: complete spring field and all seven globals replay with exact frame-zero/node-order compatibility in pinned official PhysTwin
decision_rule.advance: A capacity and backend-export pass may motivate a separately locked source-only causal architecture. It never authorizes reuse of this checkpoint or these all-frame parameters for predictive evaluation.

forbidden: calling this variant the published MatPhys method
calling any metric from this control causal, predictive, held-out, transferred, calibrated, or state of the art
using this case to tune a fresh target-facing selector
altering the frozen Deform360 v6.1 candidate or scorer
using held-v8 runtime, target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifacts
opening any fresh target or confirmation outcome
